server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: The public room name shown to players in the browser and favorites list.

max_players.title: Player Slots
max_players.description: Maximum number of connected players. Enshrouded currently supports 1 to 16 slots.

server_tags.title: Server Tags
server_tags.description: Select the official language and activity tags accepted by Enshrouded. Store one tag per line when editing raw JSON.

voice_chat_mode.title: Voice Chat Mode
voice_chat_mode.description: Chooses whether voice uses proximity range or a global channel.

enable_voice_chat.title: Enable Voice Chat
enable_voice_chat.description: Turns the voice system on or off for the whole server.

enable_text_chat.title: Enable Text Chat
enable_text_chat.description: Turns the in-game text chat on or off for the whole server.

game_settings_preset.title: Difficulty Preset
game_settings_preset.description: Only the Custom preset applies the detailed gameplay controls below.

player_health_factor.title: Player Health
player_health_factor.description: Scales player max health. The game presents this as a percentage.

player_mana_factor.title: Player Mana
player_mana_factor.description: Scales player max mana. The game presents this as a percentage.

player_stamina_factor.title: Player Stamina
player_stamina_factor.description: Scales player max stamina. The game presents this as a percentage.

player_body_heat_factor.title: Cold Resistance
player_body_heat_factor.description: Controls how much body heat players can keep in very cold areas.

player_diving_time_factor.title: Diving Time
player_diving_time_factor.description: Changes how long players can stay underwater before running out of oxygen.

shroud_time_factor.title: Shroud Time
shroud_time_factor.description: Scales how long players can remain inside the Shroud.

enable_durability.title: Enable Weapon Durability
enable_durability.description: Turn this off if you want weapons to stop breaking.

enable_starving_debuff.title: Enable Starvation
enable_starving_debuff.description: When enabled, starving players will lose health until they eat or drink.

food_buff_duration_factor.title: Food Buff Duration
food_buff_duration_factor.description: Scales the duration of food buffs.

hunger_to_starving_minutes.title: Hungry To Starving Minutes
hunger_to_starving_minutes.description: Elapsed minutes before the hungry state turns into starvation with health loss.

tombstone_mode.title: Tombstone Mode
tombstone_mode.description: Controls how much a player drops on death and whether a tombstone is created.

enable_glider_turbulences.title: Enable Glider Turbulence
enable_glider_turbulences.description: Turn this off to remove air turbulence from gliding.

curse_modifier.title: Shroud Curse
curse_modifier.description: Changes the chance of receiving the Shroud curse when attacked by curse sources.

weather_frequency.title: Weather Frequency
weather_frequency.description: Controls how often new weather phenomena appear in the world.

fishing_difficulty.title: Fishing Difficulty
fishing_difficulty.description: Controls how strong fish are in the fishing minigame.

day_time_minutes.title: Daytime Minutes
day_time_minutes.description: How long daytime lasts, in minutes.

night_time_minutes.title: Nighttime Minutes
night_time_minutes.description: How long nighttime lasts, in minutes.

mining_damage_factor.title: Mining Effectiveness
mining_damage_factor.description: Higher values increase mining damage, terraforming speed, and resource yield per hit.

plant_growth_speed_factor.title: Plant Growth Speed
plant_growth_speed_factor.description: Scales how quickly planted crops grow.

resource_drop_stack_amount_factor.title: Resource Gain
resource_drop_stack_amount_factor.description: Scales how many materials appear in a loot stack.

factory_production_speed_factor.title: Workstation Production Time Multiplier
factory_production_speed_factor.description: Scales how long workstation production takes; 1 keeps the original duration.

perk_upgrade_recycling_factor.title: Weapon Recycling Yield
perk_upgrade_recycling_factor.description: Controls how many runes are returned when salvaging upgraded weapons.

perk_cost_factor.title: Weapon Upgrade Cost
perk_cost_factor.description: Scales how many runes are needed to upgrade weapons.

experience_mining_factor.title: Mining Experience
experience_mining_factor.description: Scales XP gained from mining resources.

experience_exploration_quests_factor.title: Exploration Experience
experience_exploration_quests_factor.description: Scales XP gained from exploration and quest progress.

taming_startle_repercussion.title: Taming Failure Repercussion
taming_startle_repercussion.description: Defines how much taming progress is lost if wildlife is startled.

random_spawner_amount.title: Enemy Amount
random_spawner_amount.description: Controls how many enemies appear in the world.

aggro_pool_amount.title: Simultaneous Enemy Attacks
aggro_pool_amount.description: Controls how many enemies are allowed to attack at the same time.

enemy_damage_factor.title: Enemy Damage
enemy_damage_factor.description: Scales enemy damage for non-boss enemies.

enemy_health_factor.title: Enemy Health
enemy_health_factor.description: Scales enemy health for non-boss enemies.

enemy_stamina_factor.title: Enemy Stun Resistance
enemy_stamina_factor.description: Higher values make enemies harder to stun.

enemy_perception_range_factor.title: Enemy Perception Range
enemy_perception_range_factor.description: Scales how far non-boss enemies can see and hear players.

threat_bonus.title: Enemy Attack Frequency
threat_bonus.description: Scales how often non-boss enemies attack.

pacify_all_enemies.title: Pacify Enemies
pacify_all_enemies.description: When enabled, enemies do not attack until players attack first. Bosses are excluded.

admin_password.title: Admin Password
admin_password.description: Players using this password join with the Admin role. An empty password permits public access. A public role cannot enable more permissions than any password-protected role.

admin_can_kick_ban.title: Admin Can Kick Or Ban
admin_can_kick_ban.description: Allows this role to kick or ban other players.

admin_can_access_inventories.title: Admin Can Access Inventories
admin_can_access_inventories.description: Allows this role to open chests, containers, and similar storage.

admin_can_edit_world.title: Admin Can Edit World
admin_can_edit_world.description: Allows terraforming and world edits outside player bases.

admin_can_edit_base.title: Admin Can Edit Base
admin_can_edit_base.description: Allows adding or removing props and structures inside player bases.

admin_can_extend_base.title: Admin Can Extend Base
admin_can_extend_base.description: Allows placing or upgrading Flame Altars and expanding the base footprint.

admin_reserved_slots.title: Admin Reserved Slots
admin_reserved_slots.description: Keeps this many player slots available for Admin users.

custom_user_groups_json.title: Advanced: Extra User Groups JSON
custom_user_groups_json.description: JSON object or array of extra enshrouded_server.json userGroups entries. An empty password permits public access; that role cannot enable more permissions than any password-protected role. Omitted permissions default to canEditWorld=true and the other four permissions=false.

banned_player_ids.title: Banned Native Account Hashes
banned_player_ids.description: One native account hash from Enshrouded's bans accountId per line or comma-separated (0..18446744073709551615). Steam IDs are not converted. Entries are written to the native bans array at launch.
